repos.excerpt: TorchGeo is a [PyTorch](https://pytorch.org/) domain library, similar to [torchvision](https://docs.pytorch.org/vision), providing datasets, samplers, transforms, and pre-trained models specific to geospatial data. The goal of this library is to make it simple: 1. for machine learning experts to work with geospatial data, and 2. for remote sensing experts to explore machine learning solutions.
